home.feature_route_planning_desc: Optimize routes in seconds with advanced algorithms that consider distance, traffic, fuel costs, and delivery windows.
home.feature_tracking_desc: Monitor every vehicle in your fleet with live GPS tracking, geofencing, and instant alerts.
home.feature_dispatch_desc: Assign jobs automatically based on driver availability, truck status, and proximity.
home.feature_ocr_desc: Scan and digitize invoices, CMRs, and receipts with AI-powered OCR.
home.feature_analytics_desc: Gain actionable insights with dashboards, KPIs, and customizable reports.
home.feature_driver_desc: Manage driver profiles, licenses, medical certificates, and performance.
home.benefit_cost_desc: Cut fuel consumption by up to 20%% with optimized routing, reduce idle time, and minimize maintenance costs.
home.benefit_speed_desc: Complete more deliveries per day with intelligent route optimization and real-time traffic avoidance.
home.benefit_paperwork_desc: Digitize all documents with OCR, automate invoicing, and go fully paperless.
home.benefit_scale_desc: From 5 vehicles to 500, our platform grows with your business without missing a beat.
home.testimonial_1: Operion transformed our operations. We cut route planning time by 80%% and fuel costs by 15%% in the first quarter.
home.testimonial_2: Having real-time visibility into our fleet has been a game-changer. Our customers love the accurate ETAs.
home.testimonial_3: We scaled from 10 to 50 vehicles without adding a single dispatcher. Operion's automation is incredible.
home.hero_description: Operion ERP gives your fleet the power to plan smarter, dispatch faster, and grow bigger.
home.section_features: Everything you need to run your fleet
home.section_features_desc: Powerful tools that work together to streamline every aspect of your logistics operations.
home.section_benefits_desc: Every feature is designed to solve a real problem our customers faced.

home.section_mission_desc: Our mission is to make enterprise logistics software accessible, powerful, and easy to use.

features.page_header_desc: Alles, was Sie fuer einen effizienten Fuhrparkbetrieb benoetigen, von der Routenplanung bis zur Analytik.
features.route_planning_desc: Fortschrittliche Algorithmen optimieren Zeit, Strecke, Kraftstoff und Mautkosten in ganz Europa.
features.multi_stop_desc: Planen Sie komplexe Multi-Stop-Routen mit bis zu 50 Wegpunkten und automatisierter Reihenfolge.
features.traffic_desc: Routen passen sich dynamisch an aktuelle Verkehrsbedingungen und Strassensperrungen an.
features.gps_tracking_desc: Monitor every vehicle's location, speed, and status on an interactive map.
features.maintenance_desc: Planen und verfolgen Sie Wartungen mit automatischen Warnungen fuer Inspektionen, Versicherungen und Services.
features.geofencing_desc: Legen Sie geografische Grenzen fest und erhalten Sie sofortige Benachrichtigungen, wenn Fahrzeuge Zonen betreten oder verlassen.
features.auto_assign_desc: Ordnen Sie Auftraege den besten verfuegbaren Fahrern und LKWs basierend auf Standort, Qualifikation und Compliance zu.
features.pod_desc: Erfassen Sie Unterschriften, Fotos und Zeitstempel bei Lieferung fuer einen vollstaendigen Liefernachweis.
features.status_updates_desc: Verfolgen Sie jeden Auftrag von der Zuweisung bis zum Abschluss mit Live-Statusaktualisierungen.
features.ocr_ai_desc: Scannen und digitalisieren Sie Rechnungen, CMRs, Quittungen und Vertraege mit KI-gestuetzter OCR.
features.digital_archive_desc: Speichern und durchsuchen Sie alle Dokumente mit Versionsverlauf, Schlagwoertern und Volltextsuche.
features.auto_invoicing_desc: Generieren Sie Rechnungen automatisch aus Lieferdaten und senden Sie sie per E-Mail an Kunden.
features.dashboards_desc: Erstellen Sie personalisierte Ansichten mit KPIs, Diagrammen und Echtzeitdaten.
features.kpi_desc: ueberwachen Sie wichtige Leistungsindikatoren wie Gewinn pro km, Kraftstoffeffizienz und Fahrerleistung.
features.export_desc: Exportieren Sie Berichte in mehreren Formaten und integrieren Sie diese in Ihre bestehenden ERP- und Buchhaltungssysteme.
features.driver_profiles_desc: Vollstaendige Fahrerdatenbank mit Fuehrerscheinen, aerztlichen Untersuchungen, Vertraegen und Dokumenten.
features.driver_performance_desc: ueberwachen Sie Fahrereffizienz, Sicherheitswerte, Tachograph-Compliance und Lenkzeiten.
features.schedule_desc: Planen Sie Fahrerschichten, verwalten Sie Verfuegbarkeiten und verfolgen Sie Arbeitszeiten.

about.page_header_desc: We're building the future of enterprise logistics software.
about.story_p1: Operion wurde 2024 mit einer klaren Mission gegruendet: Unternehmenslogistik-Software fuer Flotten aller Groessen zugaenglich zu machen.
about.story_p2: Unser Team vereint jahrzehntelange Erfahrung in Logistik, Softwareentwicklung und KI, um Werkzeuge zu entwickeln, die echte Probleme loesen.
about.story_p3: Heute betreibt Operion Flotten in ganz Europa und hilft ihnen, intelligenter zu planen, schneller zu disponieren und groesser zu wachsen.
about.values_desc: Die Prinzipien, die jede unserer Entscheidungen leiten.
about.value_customer_desc: Jede Funktion beginnt mit echten Kundenbeduerfnissen und Rueckmeldungen.
about.value_reliability_desc: Ihr Betrieb haengt von unserer Software ab. Diese Verantwortung nehmen wir ernst.
about.value_innovation_desc: Wir investieren massiv in F&E, um modernste KI und Optimierung in die Logistik zu bringen.
about.value_transparency_desc: Klare Preise, ehrliche Kommunikation und keine versteckten Gebuehren.
about.value_security_desc: Verschluesselung auf Unternehmensniveau, DSGVO-Compliance und regelmaessige Sicherheitsaudits.
about.value_partnership_desc: We don't just sell software. We partner with our customers for their success.
about.team_desc: Our team combines decades of experience in logistics, software engineering, and AI.

app_overview.title: Welcome to Operion ERP
app_overview.welcome: Welcome to Operion ERP! This quick tour will show you around the main sections so you can get started right away. Use the controls below to skip or cancel at any time.
app_overview.sidebar: This is the navigation sidebar. Click any item to switch screens. Let's explore the main sections together.
app_overview.fleet: Fleet — manage all your vehicles here. View health scores, locations, and maintenance history for every truck.
app_overview.drivers: Drivers — manage driver information, licenses, tachograph data, and hours of service. Add new drivers and track their compliance.
app_overview.trips: Trips — create and manage trips. The system calculates profitability including fuel, tolls, and driver costs.
app_overview.dispatch: Dispatch Board — use the Kanban-style board to quickly assign trucks and drivers to trips. Drag and drop to update statuses.
app_overview.copilot: AI Co-Pilot — your natural language assistant. Ask questions about your data, request actions, or get step-by-step help. Available in 22 languages.
app_overview.complete: That's it! You're all set to use Operion. If you ever have questions, simply ask the AI Co-Pilot. Happy dispatching!

add_driver.title: Add a New Driver
add_driver.navigate: First, navigate to the Drivers section using the sidebar.
add_driver.click_add: Click the 'Add Driver' button to open the new driver form.
add_driver.fill_form: Fill in the driver's name and details in the form fields.
add_driver.save: Click 'Save' to create the new driver record.
add_driver.complete: The driver has been added! You can now assign them to trips.

generate_invoice.title: Generate an Invoice
generate_invoice.navigate: Navigate to the Invoices section using the sidebar.
generate_invoice.click_new: Click the 'New Invoice' button to create a new invoice.
generate_invoice.fill_client: Select a client from the client field. The invoice will be addressed to them.
generate_invoice.add_items: Add line items to the invoice — descriptions, quantities, and amounts.
generate_invoice.complete: The invoice is ready to be finalized and sent to the client.

dispatch_trip.title: Dispatch a Trip
dispatch_trip.navigate: Navigate to the Dispatch Board using the sidebar.
dispatch_trip.select_trip: Click on a trip card to select it and see its details.
dispatch_trip.assign_truck: Click 'Assign Truck' to select a vehicle for this trip.
dispatch_trip.assign_driver: Click 'Assign Driver' to select a driver for this trip.
dispatch_trip.confirm: Review the assignment details and click 'Confirm' to dispatch the trip.
dispatch_trip.complete: The trip has been dispatched! The driver and truck are now assigned.

schedule_maintenance.title: Schedule Maintenance
schedule_maintenance.navigate: Navigate to the Maintenance section using the sidebar.
schedule_maintenance.fill_details: Enter the vehicle, type of service, and any notes for the maintenance team.
schedule_maintenance.complete: Maintenance has been scheduled! You'll get a reminder when it's due.
